title: BEN: Cash earnings up 7.6% and new partnerships to drive $65–75M annual savings by FY28 - TradingView
summary: BEN: Cash earnings up 7.6% and new partnerships to drive $65–75M annual savings by FY28 TradingView
body:
Cash earnings rose 7.6% sequentially to $137.9M, with NIM up to 1.98% and lending growth accelerating. Strategic partnerships with Infosys and Genpact are set to deliver $65–75M in annual expense benefits by FY28, despite upfront transition costs.

Original document: Bendigo & Adelaide Bank Ltd. [BEN] Earnings Release — Apr. 8 2026
